_doc: The scroll path of the submission video (npm run capture). Seconds. 'hold' rests on each chapter and 'holds' overrides it per chapter; a move between two chapters takes 'scroll' seconds per screen height of the story's scroll track, and 'moves' overrides it per chapter left. The first chapter rests 'intro' seconds; the last 'final' seconds, its timeline (the light going out, the landing, the silence) at real-time pace. 'seed' fixes the sound's random choices.
